sources.snippet: VehicleNet-Y26s VehicleNet-Y26s is another multi-class vehicle detection model designed for fine-grained vehicle type recognition in real-world traffic scenes. The model is trained on UVH-26-MV Dataset released by IISc Banaglore. The dataset is based on Indian traffic which is highly challenging, dense and heterogeneous.
